# plaid

**Tag**: web

## 简介

Ruby gem wrapper for the Plaid API. Read more at the homepage, the wiki, or in the Plaid documentation.

## 官网

- 主页: https://plaid.com
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/plaid/plaid-ruby
- 文档: https://github.com/plaid/plaid-ruby/wiki
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/plaid
